definition: גִּלָּיוֺן noun masculine table, tablet (Talmud גִּלְיוֺן , the empty margin of page or roll, see Lag GN 1881, 403 , compare BN 199) — קַחלְֿךָ גִּלָּיוֺן גָּדוֺל וּכְתֹב עָלָיו take thee a great tablet and write upon it Isa 8:1 plural הַגִּלְֹינִים tablets of polished metal, mirrors Isa 3:23 ᵑ7 ᵑ9 Ges Che Di De ; but transparent garments, gauzes , ᵐ5 Ew (compare Arabic fine garment ).
